description: This file contains functions for platform-specific upgrade and configuration management in a Linux-based embedded system, specifically for bcm27xx hardware. It includes procedures for checking images, performing upgrades, setting root partitions, copying configurations, and restoring backups.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided image matches the existing partition layout, alerting if changes are detected.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade process, optionally saving partitions and writing a new image.

methods.name: bcm27xx_set_root_part
methods.description: Sets the root partition UUID in boot configuration.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files from backup to the current system, updating the root partition UUID.

methods.name: platform_restore_backup
methods.description: Restores system backup from a tar archive and updates root partition settings.
